findings.title: Cleanup registers removal of literal alias "alias" instead of the created IDPs
findings.body: The cleanup is registered as `testRealm().identityProviders().get("alias")::remove`, which targets an IDP whose alias is the literal string "alias". The IDPs the test actually creates (`idp-alias-0`..`idp-alias-20`) are never removed. The same mistake appears at line 425 and was copied from `testCacheIDPByOrg` (line 303). Leftover IDPs can make other tests in the class order-dependent, for example tests that count IDPs or check login caches. It should be `get("idp-alias-" + i)` and `get("idp-alias-20")`, with the loop variable captured in a final local.

findings.title: remove() now always performs an extra uncached DB lookup
findings.body: `idpDelegate.getByAlias(alias)` is now called unconditionally before the delegate removal, even when the cached entry is available. Before this change the DB lookup only happened when the cache key was already invalidated. Every IDP removal now issues an extra JPA query, used only to decide on login-cache invalidation. The cached model, when present, could be used for the login predicate instead, falling back to the DB only when nothing is cached.
